input.answer: Regular unleaded gasoline at self-service filling stations in Montréal, Quebec cost 198.4 cents per litre in September 2026 (2026-09). For context, August 2026 was 184.9 cents per litre, so the monthly change was (198.4 − 184.9) / 184.9 × 100 = 7.3%. Source: Statistics Canada table 18-10-0001, Monthly average retail prices for gasoline and fuel oil, by geography (vector 735096).
